steps: Verify https://hkgpipi.com returns the approved production site.
Verify HTTP redirects to HTTPS and www redirects to the approved non-www canonical if www exists.
Verify intended production indexable routes return HTTP 200.
Verify /sitemap.xml returns the seven production URLs.
Verify production pages emit index/follow where intended, correct canonical, correct Open Graph URL, correct JSON-LD, and no workers.dev identity.
Submit https://hkgpipi.com/sitemap.xml in Google Search Console.
Submit the production sitemap in Bing Webmaster Tools if it was not imported automatically.
Use Google URL Inspection on the homepage once the production site is live.
Request indexing of the homepage only if the inspector shows it is eligible and the operator wants to accelerate discovery.
Monitor pages/indexing, sitemap processing, crawl errors, search queries/impressions, and structured-data warnings.
